Long Range，线性调频扩频（CSS）调制：把每个数据位展开成多个码片，以: Long Range, a chirp spread spectrum (CSS) modulation: each data bit is spread over multiple chips, trading speed for range and low power; typical rates are about 0.3–50 kbps.
基于 LoRa 的开源离网网状通信项目，用廉价 LoRa 模块组网，适合无基础设: An open-source off-grid mesh networking project built on LoRa radios; it forms networks from cheap LoRa modules for places without infrastructure, usually operating on licence-exempt ISM / micro-power bands.
Amateur Radio Emergency Data Network：在 2: Amateur Radio Emergency Data Network: repurposes re-flashed commercial Wi-Fi gear on 2.4 / 5.8 GHz as a high-speed data network for emergency communications; an amateur licence is required.
每个数据位被展开成 2^SF 个码片；SF 越大越抗噪、越慢，SF7 最快、SF: Each data bit is spread into 2^SF chips; the larger SF is, the more noise-tolerant but slower it gets — SF7 is fastest, SF12 reaches furthest.
调制带宽（kHz）；越宽速率越高、灵敏度越低。: Modulation bandwidth (kHz); wider means faster but less sensitive.
前向纠错的冗余比例，从 4/5 到 4/8；冗余越少越快、越容易被干扰破坏。: The redundancy of the forward error correction, from 4/5 to 4/8; less redundancy is faster but easier to corrupt.
每升一级，灵敏度提高约 2.5 dB、速率减半：SF 越大传得越远但越慢。: Each step up adds about 2.5 dB of sensitivity and halves the rate: larger SF goes further but slower.
越宽速率越高、灵敏度越低；越窄越抗噪但越慢。: Wider is faster but less sensitive; narrower is more noise-tolerant but slower.
冗余越少越快、越容易被干扰破坏。: Less redundancy is faster but easier to corrupt.
符号时间 > 16 ms 时建议开启（125 kHz 下即 SF11 / SF1: Recommended when the symbol time exceeds 16 ms (SF11 / SF12 at 125 kHz)
符号时间太长时，晶振误差会让收发失同步；开启可纠正长时间符号的漂移。: When the symbol time is very long, crystal error desynchronises the link; enabling this corrects the drift of long symbols.
需业余执照，功率按执照等级；用 LoRa 技术在此频段通信同样需要执照。: An amateur licence is required, with power per the licence class; using LoRa technology on this band still requires a licence.
免执照，功率极低（毫瓦级）；具体限值以工信部现行规定为准。: Licence-exempt, very low power (milliwatt level); exact limits follow the current MIIT rules.
免执照，发射功率 ≤ 50 mW（e.r.p.）；限无线抄表等组网用途。: Licence-exempt, transmit power ≤ 50 mW (e.r.p.); limited to wireless metering and similar networking uses.
欧美 LoRa 常用频段: LoRa bands common in Europe / the Americas
中国大陆不适用，不要套用。: Not applicable in mainland China — do not copy.
LoRa 以低速换远距离与低功耗，适合传感器、短报文、位置上报，不适合语音和视频: LoRa trades speed for range and low power: good for sensors, short messages and position reports, not for voice or video.
Meshtastic 走免执照的微功率频段：功率受限、通信不加密，别当高可用或保: Meshtastic runs on licence-exempt micro-power bands: power is limited and traffic is unencrypted — don't use it as a high-availability or confidential link.
AREDN 是业余高速数据骨干，需要执照，用于应急通信的站点互联。: AREDN is an amateur high-speed data backbone that needs a licence, used to interconnect sites for emergency communications.
同一段 430–440 MHz 里，业余台（次要业务、需执照、可大功率）与微功率: In the same 430–440 MHz span, amateur stations (secondary, licensed, high power) coexist with micro-power devices (licence-exempt, milliwatts); the two legal statuses must not be confused.
频率与功率以工信部现行规定为准，国外常用的 868 / 915 MHz 不能照搬: Follow the current MIIT rules for frequency and power; the 868 / 915 MHz used abroad cannot be carried over to mainland China.
